title: Hidden functional tests are still manual because the runner and test-case execution path are disabled

original_titles.title: Predefined and hidden functional tests are manual-only; no automated testing of repaired apps

problem: The participant source-code/artifact workflow is now available, but POST /runs is unavailable and GT test cases are not automatically executed in the submission pipeline. Admin records tests_passed/tests_total manually through the ground-truth test-results endpoint.
impact: The proposal’s hidden-test evaluation cannot be demonstrated as automated. Manual test scoring is more error-prone and depends on an operator checklist.

verification.basis: Current source inspection at the main-branch commit listed in metadata. Original audit line numbers are treated as historical and were not reused as current line references.

implementation_steps.action: For the current event, explicitly define a manual test protocol and a two-person recording/check process; keep raw test evidence linked to each submission.
For future automated testing, implement the isolated runner as a separate project and build a versioned test-case manifest in GT.
Record each test result with test_case_id, test-suite version/hash, runner image digest, run id, output hash and actor; do not accept only aggregate passed/total values.
Add idempotent result ingestion and an audit trail so repeated submissions cannot double-award functional-test points.

acceptance_criteria: Current event manual testing has a documented, reproducible checklist and dual verification.
Any future automated run is isolated and produces per-test evidence.
regression_tests: Add a focused failing test before implementation where practical.
Add a negative authorization / boundary test, not only a happy-path test.
Run the affected backend/frontend suite and the full CI workflow before merge.

residual_risk_or_scope_note: The four-level artifact submission surface is fixed; the unimplemented part is execution/hidden-test automation.
